title: Pin mutable evidence sources to immutable revisions
description: 33 of 162 evidence entries cite a mutable branch tip (raw.githubusercontent.com/<org>/<repo>/main/...) or a bare GitHub repo landing page. Those sources mutate continuously, so their mechanism quotes drift and the weekly recheck fails again regardless of how often evidence is refreshed - incident-automation[0] (github.com/akmatori/akmatori) drifted within a month of being refreshed by PR #110 on 2026-08-16. Consider citing a commit-pinned permalink (raw.githubusercontent.com/<org>/<repo>/<sha>/README.md) so content_sha256 and mechanism_quote stay stable, and the recheck measures real withdrawal of a claim rather than routine README editing. Requires a rubric decision: a pinned URL proves the mechanism existed at that revision, not that it still ships.

title: Give hydrate-evidence-content.py a safe standalone recheck mode (issue #119)
description: Issue #119: hydrate() writes retrieved but never last_checked or search.checked_at, so the default path produces an invalid file and --retrieved-date <old last_checked> silently backdates provenance. Add --recheck: re-fetch every admitted source, require every mechanism_quote still present, then advance retrieved and last_checked atomically while leaving search.checked_at pinned to the search run that actually happened. Reject a --retrieved-date older than an entry's current retrieved. Refuse to run with no mode selected. Relax validate-evidence.py 'checked_at must equal last_checked' to 'must not be after', which is what makes a model-free recheck (trust-model operation 2) expressible without claiming a search that did not occur. scripts/ and tests/ are protected trust roots: needs an owner APPROVE TRUST ROOT round.

title: Decompose scripts/validate-evidence.py (1024 lines, 38 smell violations)
description: The smell hook reports 38 pre-existing violations: the file is 1024 lines (max 300), validate_search is 116 lines at complexity 55, validate_top_fields 75 lines at complexity 43, validate_entry 64 lines at complexity 37 with 7 params. Verified as pre-existing: running the same checker against HEAD and against the h19 edit both report exactly 38, so the recheck change added none. Deliberately not refactored inside the CI fix. scripts/ is a protected trust root, so every byte of difference has to be justified to an owner typing APPROVE TRUST ROOT; a full restructure buried in an evidence-refresh PR makes that review impossible, and it exceeds the 400-line scope ceiling. Wants its own PR whose entire diff is the decomposition, with the evidence corpus as the regression oracle: validate every verification/evidence/*.yaml before and after and assert identical output.
